# Capture checklist: Mountain adventure

## Via ferrata (`mountain.ferrata`)

**route**: R name, type, area_id, summary, access_points, access_cost, price, window, links, geometry, starts_at; R? point (conditional), class_key (conditional), draw (conditional), standing (conditional), distinction (conditional), easy_payoff (conditional), weather (conditional), why (conditional), signals (conditional), closures (status_page); A names, wikidata, osm_ref, best_window, best_time, transit, pairs_with, photos, part_of, passes, high_point_m, turnaround_points, gpx_licence, snow_free_window.

Suitability: R min_age, min_weight_kg, max_weight_kg, limit_reason, adult_required, age_band, kid_note, effort.source_grade, effort.drivers.gain_m, adult_time_min, bail_out, exposure, altitude_m, access_season, participation.guide, participation.kit_provided, participation.wear, participation.fitness, participation.waiver, participation.weather_cancel, ext.ferrata.kit; R when operated none; A min_height_cm, max_height_cm, effort.drivers.distance_km, effort.drivers.loss_m, signal, hazards, participation.min_shoe_eu, participation.medical, participation.pregnancy, ext.ferrata.kit_weight_note, ext.ferrata.child_harness, ext.ferrata.approach_min, ext.ferrata.descent.
